Joining a Battle with Characters on a team means that the Characters will acquire EXP.
Characters will level up when their EXP gauge reaches 100%.

Acquired upon Level Up:
▶Additional stats
▶Increased Max Skill Level
▶[cortado]

Collect biometrics and rank up to 6.
Mutants can rank up using X-Genes.

Acquired after Rank Up:
▶Bonus Stats
▶Max Level
▶[cortado]

Use Norn Stones to increase mastery up to 6.
Mutants can increase mastery using M’kraan Crystal Shards.

Acquired after increasing mastery:
▶Bonus Stats
▶Leader Skill

Use Norn Stones of Chaos, Black Anti-matter, Norn Stones, and Biometrics to advance a character with max mastery, max gear upgrades, level 60, Tier-1 to Tier-2.
Mutants can use M’kraan Crystals and Phoenix Feathers to advance to Tier-2.

Acquired after advancing:
▶Bonus Stats
▶[cortado]
As your character levels up also upgrade your character’s skills. The Max Level of a character’s skill increases when the character’s level increases. (Up to level 10.)

Equipping an ISO-8 to owned characters will apply the ISO-8’s stats to the character.
A total of 8 ISO-8s can be equipped per character.

Further strengthen ISO-8s by Enhancing, Combining, and Awakening.
Equipping certain combinations of ISO-8s will also grant a ISO-8 Set Bonus.

A character can equip Custom Gear once they reach Lv. 30.
Equipping Custom Gear applies special effects to the character.
A max of 1 Custom Gear can be equipped per character.

Use Custom Gear Upgrade to further strengthen Custom Gear.

Comic Cards are equippable on card slots.
Equipping a Comic Card applies its stats to all characters.
A max of 5 cards can be equipped.
※Only one of a card type can be equipped at a time.

Further strengthen a Comic Card through Comic Card Upgrades.

Once your character’s gear reaches a certain level, Enchanted Uru can be equipped.
When Enchanted Uru is equipped, character’s stats increase by Uru’s stats.
Slots for Uru will be unlocked at specific gear levels, and each gear can equip up to 5 Uru.
Up to 2 Uru with the same Option can be equipped per gear.
Up to 1 Odin’s Blessing can be equipped.

Collect experience by fighting in various stages, then use materials to upgrade the stats of a character’s Uniform.
When a uniform is upgraded, it will get bonus stats depending on the Uniform Rank. It can be boosted up to Mythic.
You must have a Specific Uniform of another character to do this.

Characters that have advanced to Tier-2 can search for their hidden Potential.
If World Boss content is cleared with the target character after searching for Potential, you gain Potential Points.
Once Potential Points are obtained, you can realize a character's Potential.
Realized Potential can be enhanced using materials such as Cosmic Cube Fragments. Potential can be enhanced up to 6 times after the 1st Potential unlock, and up to 12 times after the 2nd Potential unlock.
Max level increases each time Potential is realized.

Some characters that have realized their potential can awaken their potential upon reaching level 70.
Awakening Crystals and other materials are required to awaken potential. Awakened Skills can be used when potential is awakened.

*Only some characters can awaken their potential currently. More characters will be able to awaken their potential in the future.

Characters that leveled up their awakened skill to max can Awaken their Potential. Awakening Crystals and Mandalay Gems are required to awaken a character's potential, which results in increased character stats.

※Characters must awaken their potential to transcend their potential, and more characters will be able to awaken and transcend their potentials in time.

Characters that are Level 70 with all of their gear enhanced to +25 can be advanced to Tier-3.
Required materials for advancement are Titan’s Records that fit the character’s Type, Cosmic Cube Fragments, Essence of Dimension, and Titan Component Packs.

Acquired upon Advancement:
▶Additional Stats
▶[cortado]

Tier-3 or Potential Transcended Characters that are Level 80 with all of their gear enhanced to +30 and all skills at Lv. 10 can be advanced to Tier-4.
Required materials for advancement are Book of the Vishanti that fit the character's Type, Life Seed, Carbonadium, and Soul of the Faltine.

Acquired upon Advancement:
▶[cortado]

Raid Level increases with Raid EXP gained from clearing World Boss.
When Raid Level increases, certain stats are increased. The increased stats are only applicable within World Boss content.

Stats gained upon Level Up:
▶All ATK ↑
▶[cortado]

Characters that have reached level 60 and realized their potential can upgrade their type.
Type Enhancement Kit in accordance with character type can be used as materials.

Type Enhancement Effects:
▶Increased damage based on enemy type
▶Decreased damage received based on enemy type

Agent Level automatically increases when increasing the tiers of Hero Badge and Agent Badge.

Rank up, advance, transcend potential of your characters to increase Hero Badge tier.
Agent Badge can be enhanced using 6★ or higher character upgrade items, Agent Kits, or Agent Tokens.

Bonus Points are acquired according to Agent Level, and they can be used to strengthen various stats.
Stats strengthened by Bonus Points apply to all characters.

S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive is where data is stored from various contents

This data is collected by playing content or combining data.
Data combination is a system that acquires data using items stored in the inventory.

When a certain amount of data is obtained, Growth items and Instinct stats are granted as a reward.
[cortado]

Team-Up Collection is content where your aim is to increase character stats corresponding to a specific theme.

Team-Up Options are unlocked by completing challenges related to character growth and uniform upgrade. You can select and apply your picks from the unlocked team-up options.

Team-up options can be leveled up using Gold, and Collection Tokens can be acquired as rewards at specific levels.

You can enhance Collection Options with the Collection Tokens you've acquired, and enhancing a collection option will increase character stats corresponding to the specific theme.

Emblems have special effects that apply only to certain content.
Leveling up an emblem using the same rarity of Emblem Data and Emblem Enhancement Kit will enhance the effects even further.

Only Tier-4 characters with Character Level +80, and gear upgrade +30 or higher can unlock Elite Gear.

You can level up Elite Gears by consuming level up materials.
When leveling up, you obtain Gear Points.
You can use Gear Points to upgrade gear stats of your choice.

To level up past a certain level, you must perform a level limit break.
When you successfully perform a level limit break, you can obtain Specialization Points.
You can use Specialization Points to upgrade specialization stats of your choice.

*Elite Gear may be applied differently depending on the hero.

You can equip a J.A.R.V.I.S. Preset to your team, consisting of an Attack Chip, Defense Chip, and Special Chip.
Teams equipped with a J.A.R.V.I.S. Preset receive the stat increase effects of the equipped J.A.R.V.I.S. Chips.

J.A.R.V.I.S. Chips can be enhanced to increase their stats or have their stats changed by changing their options.

* A single J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip can be equipped to multiple Presets at the same time.
